workflowCompleteDialog.description: Current final stage: "{{stageName}}". Confirming will complete the workflow.

schedulerApproval.createDescription: Review the scheduled task configuration. After confirmation, the task will be saved and scheduled according to its enabled state.
schedulerApproval.updateNotFound: Current scheduled task was not found, so the full configuration cannot be loaded.
schedulerApproval.updateLoadFailed: Failed to load current scheduled task configuration.
schedulerApproval.deleteDescription: Deleting a scheduled task also removes all execution records for that task. This action cannot be undone.
schedulerApproval.deleteWarning: If the task is currently running, abort it before deleting.
schedulerApproval.enableDescription: After enabling, the scheduled task will run automatically according to its Cron expression.
schedulerApproval.disableDescription: After disabling, the scheduled task will no longer run automatically, but its configuration and history are kept.
schedulerApproval.runNowDescription: Trigger one execution of the scheduled task immediately without waiting for the next scheduled time. The task will run with its current prompt and parameters.
schedulerApproval.abortDescription: Abort the currently running scheduled task agent. Execution will be interrupted, and generated output will be kept.
schedulerApproval.abortWarning: Aborting immediately terminates the agent run, so the current execution state may be incomplete.

batchTasksApproval.projectLoadNotFound: Current batch project was not found, so the full configuration cannot be loaded.
batchTasksApproval.projectLoadFailed: Failed to load current batch project configuration.
batchTasksApproval.projectCreateSummary: Review the batch project configuration. After confirmation, one subtask will be created for each source folder.
batchTasksApproval.projectUpdateSummary: Review the batch project changes to write. The confirmation UI has merged the current configuration and will only append new source folders.
batchTasksApproval.projectDeleteSummary: Confirm whether to delete this batch project, all subtasks, session state, and task artifacts. This action cannot be undone.
batchTasksApproval.projectFullAccessWarning: Tasks will run with full access and may read or modify files inside and outside the selected folders. Confirm that the prompt and folders are trusted.
batchTasksApproval.notFoundInCurrentList: Not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.projectNotFoundInCurrentList: Project not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.taskNotFoundInCurrentList: Task not found in the current list
batchTasksApproval.projectDeleteWarning: This permanently deletes the project directory, all task records, session state, and task artifacts. The operation will be rejected if tasks are running or queued.
batchTasksApproval.resumeTextLabel: Additional message to send to the original session
batchTasksApproval.taskRunSummary: Confirm whether to create a session for this pending subtask and start running it.
batchTasksApproval.taskRunDescription: Create a session for this pending task and start running it.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetrySummary: Confirm whether to clear the old result for this subtask and rerun it from the start.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetryDescription: Clear old results and rerun this task from the start.
batchTasksApproval.taskRetryWarning: Old sessions, state, and existing artifacts in the task directory will be deleted and cannot be restored.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopSummary: Confirm whether to abort or remove this subtask and clean its session, state, and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopDescription: Abort running or queued tasks and reset the state to pending.
batchTasksApproval.taskStopWarning: The current session, run state, and existing artifacts in the task directory will be deleted.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSummary: Confirm whether to permanently delete this subtask and its related data from the project.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteDescription: Permanently remove this task from the project.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteWarning: Task records, project subdirectory, session state, and artifacts will be permanently deleted.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeSummary: Confirm whether to send "Continue" to the paused original session and keep existing context.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeDescription: Send "Continue" to the paused original session while keeping existing context and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextTitle: Resume Batch Subtask with Message Confirmation
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextSummary: Confirm the additional message to send to the paused session. Existing context will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.taskResumeWithTextDescription: Send the additional message to the paused original session, then continue execution.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionSummary: Confirm whether to delete the conversation session associated with this subtask. Task records and task directories are kept.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionDescription: Delete the conversation session associated with this task.
batchTasksApproval.taskDeleteSessionWarning: Session history cannot be restored. Task records and task directories will not be deleted.
batchTasksApproval.resetFailedPartialWarning: Only tasks currently in the Failed state will be processed. Other task IDs will be ignored.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllSummary: Confirm whether to delete all non-running subtasks in this project. Running tasks will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllDescription: Delete all non-running tasks in the project. Running tasks will be kept.
batchTasksApproval.executionDeleteAllWarning: Queued tasks will be removed from the queue, then task records, session state, and artifact directories will be permanently deleted.
batchTasksApproval.executionStartSummary: Confirm whether to start executing this batch project. Pending and paused tasks will enter the execution flow.
batchTasksApproval.executionStartDescription: Queue all pending tasks and resume paused tasks. Completed or failed tasks will not rerun.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopSummary: Confirm whether to stop unfinished tasks in this project and clean related sessions, state, and artifacts.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopDescription: Stop all unfinished tasks in the project while keeping completed tasks.
batchTasksApproval.executionStopWarning: Queued, running, failed, and paused task sessions, state, and artifact directories will be cleaned and reset to pending.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetTitle: Clear and Rerun Batch Project Confirmation
batchTasksApproval.executionResetSummary: Confirm whether to clear all task state and artifacts in this project and rerun the whole project immediately.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetDescription: Clear the entire project execution state and artifacts, then rerun all tasks immediately.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetWarning: All task sessions, state, and artifact directories will be deleted, including completed tasks. This action cannot be undone.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedSummary: Confirm whether to clean the selected failed tasks. Only tasks currently in the Failed state will be processed.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedDescription: Clean selected failed tasks. If the project is still running, they will be queued immediately; otherwise they return to pending.
batchTasksApproval.executionResetFailedWarning: Old sessions, error state, and existing artifacts for the selected failed tasks will be deleted.
